verdict.rationale: Firstbase's own docs say existing companies can onboard and that it will "legally change your registered agent in your incorporation state," so it does file the change-of-agent paperwork itself. That coverage is stated only for the incorporation state, and nothing documents the specific change-of-agent form or filing fee for each state. Missing for 10: per-state change-of-agent form and fee documentation, evidence of agent changes in foreign-qualified states, independent or hands-on corroboration of the switching process.
